map.根据火灾类别和使用场景，推荐合适的灭火器类型与配置方案: Recommend suitable extinguisher types and configuration plans by fire class and usage scenario.
map.A类 - 固体物质火灾（木材、纸张、布料）: Class A - solid-material fires (wood, paper, cloth)
map.B类 - 液体或可熔固体火灾（汽油、酒精）: Class B - flammable liquid or meltable solid fires (gasoline, alcohol)
map.C类 - 气体火灾（天然气、丙烷）: Class C - gas fires (natural gas, propane)
map.D类 - 金属火灾（镁、钠、钾）: Class D - metal fires (magnesium, sodium, potassium)
map.E类 - 带电火灾（电气设备）: Class E - energized electrical fires (electrical equipment)
map.F类 - 烹饪油火灾（厨房动植物油）: Class F - cooking-oil fires (kitchen animal/vegetable oils)
map.：适用 A 类，不可用于 B/C/E 类: : suitable for Class A, not for Class B/C/E
map.：适用 A/B/C/E 类，通用性强: : suitable for Class A/B/C/E, highly versatile
map.：适用 B/C/E 类，不适用 A 类: : suitable for Class B/C/E, not for Class A
map.：适用 B/C/E 类，不留残留，适合精密设备: : suitable for Class B/C/E, leaves no residue, good for precision equipment
map.：适用 A/B 类，覆盖性好: : suitable for Class A/B, good coverage
map.：仅适用 D 类金属火灾: : only for Class D metal fires
map.：适用 F 类厨房油火，也适用 A 类: : suitable for Class F kitchen oil fires, also suitable for Class A
map.每个配置点不少于 2 具，不多于 5 具: No fewer than 2 and no more than 5 units per distribution point
map.本工具依据《建筑灭火器配置设计规范》GB 50140 提供参考建议，实际配置须由: This tool provides reference recommendations based on the Code for Design of Building Fire Extinguisher Configuration (GB 50140); actual configuration must be determined by professionals according to site conditions.
map.📚 深度解析：灭火器选型配置: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Extinguisher Selection and Configuration
map.办公室、商铺等场所按火灾种类与危险等级初选灭火器类型与规格。: For offices, shops and similar premises, pre-select the extinguisher type and size by fire class and hazard level.
map.场所改变用途后复核原有配置是否仍匹配新的火灾危险类别。: After a premises changes use, re-check whether the original configuration still matches the new fire-hazard class.
map.消防安全检查中快速核对配置数量与灭火级别是否满足最低要求。: During fire-safety inspections, quickly verify whether the configured quantity and extinguishing rating meet the minimum requirements.
map.办公区 A 类火灾中危险级的选型: Selection for a Class A ordinary-hazard office area
map.按默认参数（A 类火灾、中危险级、保护面积 100 m²）：推荐 ABC 干粉: With the default parameters (Class A fire, ordinary hazard, protected area 100 m²): an ABC dry powder 4 kg unit (versatile, suitable for Class A solid fires) is recommended as the primary choice, with water-based/foam as a supplement; quantity 2 units (1 unit per 75 m² and no fewer than 2), minimum extinguishing rating 3A. Clean, residue-free types are preferable in office areas to avoid soiling documents and equipment.
map.ABC 干粉能灭所有火吗？: Can ABC dry powder extinguish every kind of fire?
map.ABC 干粉覆盖 A（固体）、B（液体）、C（气体）类，通用性最强，但不能替代专: ABC dry powder covers Class A (solid), B (liquid) and C (gas) and is the most versatile, but it cannot replace the requirements of specialized locations; for energized-equipment fires the agent's insulating properties must be confirmed, and metal (Class D) fires require a specialty powder and cannot be mixed.
map.为什么最少要 2 具？: Why is a minimum of 2 units required?
map.GB 50140 要求每个设置点不宜少于 2 具，目的是一处失效、压力不足或被火: GB 50140 requires no fewer than 2 units per distribution point, so that a backup remains if one fails, is under-pressurized or is cut off by fire, and distributed placement ensures usable equipment is always near the fire's origin.
map.根据火灾类别（A~F）、使用场所和危险等级，推荐合适的灭火器类型、规格与配置数量: Recommend suitable extinguisher types, sizes and quantities by fire class (A-F), usage location and hazard level.
